name: Claw 工作流规划器
description: 从 Automation Workflows / Proactive Agent 思路改造的规划模块，把目标整理成手机端可执行的步骤、模块建议和风险提示。
description_en: Workflow planning module adapted from Automation Workflows and Proactive Agent ideas. Turns goals into mobile-friendly steps, module suggestions, and risk notes.

apis.name: planWorkflow
apis.desc: 调用宿主 LLM，把目标拆成可执行步骤、建议模块、检查点和风险提示
apis.desc_en: Use the host LLM to break a goal into steps, module suggestions, checkpoints, and risk notes

apis.name: makeChecklist
apis.desc: 不调用 LLM，把多行计划文本整理成检查清单
apis.desc_en: Convert plain plan text into a checklist without LLM

apis.name: riskCheckPlan
apis.desc: 本地检查计划中是否包含删除、转账、外发密钥等高风险动作
apis.desc_en: Locally check whether a plan contains risky actions such as deletion, payments, or secret sharing

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开 Claw 工作流规划器界面并返回 _openModule 信号
apis.desc_en: Open Claw Workflow Planner UI and return _openModule signal
